# Black Sands Oasis (BSO)

> Black Sands Oasis (БСО) — a gated cluster of intimate Desert Modernism villas
> by UNIT inside Nuanu, a 45-hectare oceanfront master-planned city on Bali's
> west coast. Seven layouts from 31 to 160 m², private pools and gardens,
> six-metre ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a managed rental programme.
> 111 units total. Developer: UNIT (unitdeveloper.com).

## Key pages
- [Black Sands Oasis — English](https://blacksandsoasis.com/): full project overview — architecture, layouts, interactive site plan, investment case, FAQ.
- [Black Sands Oasis — Russian / Русская версия](https://blacksandsoasis.com/ru/): тот же проект на русском — архитектура, планировки, план комплекса, инвестиции, вопросы.

## Facts
- Location: Nuanu cluster, Bali, Indonesia (west coast; 3 min to the ocean, 20 min to Canggu, ~1 h to Ngurah Rai airport).
- Style: Desert Modernism — perforated terracotta, natural stone, terrazzo, sandy caramel palette.
- Layouts: studio, 1BR, 1BR Sky, 2BR, 3BR, 3BR Sky, 4BR; 31–160 m².
- Guarantees: full refund if PBG licence not obtained; 25 years on structure, 5 on engineering, 1 on finishes. Leasehold 35–37 years, extendable.
- Purchase: refundable $1,500 reservation deposit, 30% first instalment, stage-linked payments. Construction and PBG from February 2026; ~2 years to delivery.

## Contact
- Developer site: https://unitdeveloper.com/
